answer_1.quote: Explanation Generation Task It requires the model to generate a free-text-formed explanation for a given causal fact (composed of a premise and the corresponding correct hypothesis).
answer_1.outputs: free-text-formed conceptual explanations for causal facts

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We automatically evaluate the quality of generated explanations using average-BLEU (n=4), ROUGE-l, Perplexity, together with our proposed CEQ score.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We also assess the quality of model-generated explanations through human evaluation. Specifically, we sampled 200 explanations generated by each method. Then three workers were shown with the generated explanations, together with corresponding causal facts, and were asked to label whether the generated explanation can explain the corresponding causal fact.
answer_4.guideline: label whether the generated explanation can explain the corresponding causal fact
